messages:
Sam Patel: FYI post-merge smoke: microbench batcher latency spiked in CI for the 512/short-seq workload.
Anya Chen: saw the alert. CI says +18% p50 vs baseline. Can someone bisect? :thinking_face:
CI Bot: microbench/batcher/512_short_seq failed threshold check. baseline=12.4ms current=14.7ms (+18.5%). build=2024.04.11-7f6a2c
Morgan Li: ugh — was there a selector tweak in that merge window? @Sam?
Sam Patel: yes — merged a tiny change to kernel auto-select heuristics (commit 7f6a2c). It biases fused-gemm for small matrices.
Anya Chen: starting a local bisect now. quick command I run: `git bisect start --term-good=baseline --term-bad=HEAD` then run the microbench harness.
Anya Chen: reproducer and flamegraph attached locally. minimal stack shows many more kernel launches and higher time in `launch_kernel()`.
Anya Chen: perf stat snippet:
```
$ perf stat -e cycles,instructions,cache-misses ./microbench_batcher --seq=512 --iters=200
  cycles:  1,235,678,900
  instructions: 1,012,345,678
  cache-misses: 34,567
```
Morgan Li: That looks like less fused work happening per launch (more per-launch overhead). Could be batching heuristic interaction rather than kernel math itself.
Sam Patel: hmm, the selector change also altered the fallback code path length prediction. If batches are getting fragmented we lose amortization.
Bench Bot: profile summary: p50 increased 18.5%, p95 +30%, kv-cache hitrate down 4.2% for short sequences.
Anya Chen: bisect results so far point to two commits: 7f6a2c (selector) and 8c9d4e1 (tiny batcher refactor). isolating...
Anya Chen: Quick test: revert 7f6a2c locally -> microbench p50 back to 12.6ms (within noise).
Sam Patel: if reverting 7f6a2c fixes it, sounds like a revert + follow-up to adjust heuristics is safest for release.
Morgan Li: agree. this is a rollout blocker for the current canary release. @PlatformOps can we hold the rolling deployment? :warning:
Sam Patel: opened revert PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/2991 (revert 7f6a2c). Marked with "rollout-blocker"
Anya Chen: re-run CI on revert branch — bench bot triggered. Please wait for microbench results.
CI Bot: Re-run triggered: build=2024.04.11-revert-2991. microbench/batcher/512_short_seq result: baseline=12.4ms current=12.5ms (+0.8%), PASS.
Bench Bot: post-revert snapshot: p50 delta -0.1% vs baseline, kv-cache hitrate restored.
Morgan Li: great. I'll coordinate a hotfix deploy to the canary pool and keep rollout blocked until metrics stable for 1 hour.
Sam Patel: follow-up action items: (1) open an RFC to make kernel selector changes gated by an integration microperf test, (2) add a regression unit test for the batching heuristic interplay, (3) write up guidance when changing selector bias.
Anya Chen: I'll add the microperf case to the PR checklist and add a quick test under perf/short_seq to catch this.
Sam Patel: thanks all. tagging this thread as resolved after the hotfix goes green. ping me if anything weird shows after the deploy. :thumbsup:
